method: Source inspection of the local main checkout. Product launch controls and diagnostics also have narrowly scoped runtime observations recorded separately below. No release-install or agent-execution validation was performed. Website browser checks are separate. Entries with their own revision and verified fields were checked against that revision instead of the record-level one.

launch.scope: Current session wizard, workspace choices, model loading and launch controls

connection.scope: Hosted connection prerequisites, tab independence, switching versus forgetting and version warnings

settings.scope: Project directories and server settings labels

chat.scope: Chat labels, send and queue controls, interruption, visible session activity

diff.scope: Changes, Commits, comparisons, Code, bounded file previews and stale data

questions.scope: Questionnaire launch labels, queueing, submission target, delivery failure and deletion

review.scope: Review entry point, focus prompt, finding sections, comments and status checks

mobile.scope: Mobile interrupt control and scrollable workspace tabs

example.scope: Locally runnable sample and exact expected outputs; agent prose is illustrative

editorial.scope: Documentation navigation, feedback process and generated text exports

project-creation.scope: Project creation controls, configured roots, README and initial commit outcomes

permissions.scope: Initial enabled autonomy, provider labels, Codex permission mapping, Claude launch flag and Antigravity controls

session-signals.scope: Sidebar activity, idle, stopping, closing, unavailable transcript and separate delivery status

review-actions.scope: Triage versus dispatch, meanings of actions, context clearing and delivery failure

diff-comparisons.scope: Diff filters labels, comparison scopes and base resolution

closing.scope: Close controls, opt-in worktree deletion, blocked deletion and asynchronous cleanup notices

diagnostics.scope: Read-only status endpoint and serverVersion/protocolVersion response fields

file-access.scope: Server workspace paths from project/workspace controls; documented shell recipe checked locally in a disposable repository. Remote SSH authentication and operator handoff remain unexercised.

question-details.scope: Depth presets, generation status, captured context, answer message and instruction to proceed immediately after submission; questionnaires are illustrative.

context-actions.scope: Managed context reset, provider replacement and Claude terminal clear before review delivery; successful clear resets conversation history, not repository files.

approval-flow.scope: Codex request titles, available decision labels and submission card; Claude parsed options and terminal fallback. Source and Codex unit checks, not live approval execution.

review-scope.scope: Default origin/main review base with origin/master fallback; committed branch comparison; refinement versus rewriting and empty-panel states.

git-refresh.scope: Prompt bar branch refresh on web and native; loading and retry indicators in Diff.

project-setup.scope: Workspace creation is separate from general project provisioning; specific Expo environment copy helper is not a generic setup guarantee. Preparation advice is an editorial workflow.

commit-action.scope: Commit dropdown groups status files and dispatches a provider action or message; no per-file checkboxes. Explicit scoped Chat commits are an editorial workflow, not an atomic commit guarantee.

browser-example.scope: Standalone original and completed greeting forms; browser-tested inputs, keyboard submission and safe text output. No live agent-generated change or commit claimed.

attachments.scope: Picker labels, upload status, staging notice and Git ignore action; provider content/path handling, retained delivery copies, and worktree lifecycle.

terminal.scope: Drawer and shell controls, cwd selection, shell access warning, separate tab termination, authorization error, and detached terminal cleanup. Source-checked; live terminal mutation not exercised.

provider-usage.scope: Provider capability differences, reported footer usage windows/details, and context window display. Does not verify billing prices, financial caps, or external account retention policies.

persistence.scope: Managed restoration from persisted session information/history, per-server client state and forgetting. No guarantee of uninterrupted commands or uniform provider restart outcomes.

install.scope: Public one-line installer: platforms, prerequisites warnings, EULA and tailnet prompts, flags, final messages, the published EULA release asset (identical to resources/EULA.md in the 1.0.0 and 1.0.1 archives), firehose commands and error messages. Source inspection of the commit Firehose 1.0.1 was built from (release build id 8d9eccaedbb5). No install on a clean machine, live activation, Stripe checkout, or hosted-app run was performed.

activation.scope: Release license gate, lock and activation screens, device-code flow, hosted /activate and /account pages, subscription checkout and billing states, renewal grace and code expiry. Exempt accounts, prices and plan names intentionally omitted. Source inspection of the commit Firehose 1.0.1 was built from (release build id 8d9eccaedbb5). No install on a clean machine, live activation, Stripe checkout, or hosted-app run was performed.

tailnet-access.scope: Owner-only tailnet access: installer prompt, --tailnet, firehose tailnet on|off|status, Settings Open from your other devices, owner-only gateway refusal, loopback-only server, Tailscale error messages. Source inspection of the commit Firehose 1.0.1 was built from (release build id 8d9eccaedbb5). No install on a clean machine, live activation, Stripe checkout, or hosted-app run was performed.

hosted-connection.scope: Hosted app at agents.okthink.ai: fixed port 4801, rejected explicit ports, .ts.net names only, and their error messages. Source inspection of the commit Firehose 1.0.1 was built from; the live hosted app was not exercised.

tailscale-setup.scope: Third-party Tailscale setup steps: download page, Linux install script and sign-in command, MagicDNS default and enable button, HTTPS certificate enable steps and public-ledger notice. Checked against Tailscale's public documentation, not a live install.

layout.scope: Where controls live in the 1.0.1 web UI: icon rail and Settings gear, Sessions sidebar and New session button, New agent session steps, workspace tabs and Chat toggle, prompt bar (folder, branch, commit, tools), message box, send, attach, context badge, stop button, Session options and Session details, mobile layout. Source inspection plus mock-data screenshots; not a live release session.

runtimeObservations.scope: Read-only GET /api/status confirmed version fields. Walked New session → documentation project → Current checkout → Codex. Observed Full Auto checked and Start session available; captured only the provider panel at desktop and mobile widths. No session was started. This differs from the source revision; approval behavior and installation were not exercised.
runtimeObservations.method: Local HTTPS request and isolated browser with mutating API requests blocked.

captures.crop: Actual provider settings panel; surrounding projects and conversations excluded. No retouching.
Actual provider settings panel; surrounding projects and conversations excluded. No retouching.

runtimeObservations.scope: Interface captures for the user guides. The real 1.0.1 web UI was driven by Playwright against the repository's e2e mock API with invented data only: the hello-firehose and hello-form practice projects under /home/you/projects, a fictional activation code, and a placeholder tailnet address. No real server, project, account, or provider was involved. Mock-only chips such as make-pr and tts are left as rendered; nothing was retouched. Hosted /activate and /account captures restore a fictional you@example.com Firebase user from browser storage and answer every Firebase and license-service request with canned responses; plan labels are the service's own (functions/src/plans.ts) and no prices appear. The license agreement capture uses shortened placeholder agreement text. The locked-screen reason uses the service's real 'subscription is <status>' wording.
runtimeObservations.method: agent-manager branch docs-screenshot-capture, e2e/tests/docs-screenshots.spec.ts, run with DOCS_SHOT_DIR and DOCS_SHOT_BROWSER=/snap/bin/chromium. Hosted pages: e2e/hosted/docs-activation.spec.ts with playwright.hosted.config.ts and placeholder EXPO_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_* settings.

sourceTestObservations.result: 4 files, 25 tests passed using the source checkout isolated temporary-database setup. No real provider execution.
sourceTestObservations.limitation: The optional Claude interactionCards.test.ts permission suite failed before tests ran: happy-dom/Vite externalized Node built-ins. A runner-loader retry also failed at config load because __dirname was undefined. Claude card behavior remains source-inspected; product files were not changed to repair that separate harness.
